The static-boolean recursion guard is the commonly taught introductory pattern; community sources (apexhours.com) note its all-or-nothing limitation versus a static Set<Id> guard, which this lesson also teaches as the more robust alternative. No single official Salesforce doc page names the recursion-guard pattern itself (it is a design pattern, not a language feature), so this lesson relies on the verified behavior of static variables persisting per-transaction (confirmed via the Apex Developer Guide trigger pages) plus secondary community sources for the pattern's shape.
